verses.1: I am the one who breaks through the darkness.
verses.2: When I was among the trees, then I also wandered among the plants.
verses.3: As I stood among the branches of the tree, my dear father, I sat down and waited patiently.
verses.4: Take me to the house of the gods, and let them mark me with the sign of love.
verses.5: I am in flames of passion; I am in a state of torment because of love’s illness.
verses.6: May She be under my head, and her right hand should hold me close to Her.
verses.7: I praise you, daughters of Jerusalem! Whether in the days of battle or in the nights of darkness, if you awaken and reignite that love, then it will be restored.
verses.8: The voice of my father is heard here, descending from the mountains, spreading over the hills.
verses.9: It’s like Dodi to Tzvi, or like the eagle that sits on our graves, watching over us from above.
verses.10: Dad replied to me, “Come here. My beautiful daughter, go with me.”
verses.11: For behold, the days have passed by; the time has come to leave.
verses.12: The trumpets sounded in the land when the time came. The sound of the trumpet was heard in our land.
verses.13: The tentacles of the monster spread out, and its tentacles emitted a pleasant scent. My beautiful thoughts and desires were filled with joy. And then I went away.
verses.14: I will celebrate the festival of the stone in its proper place. I will behold your appearance; I will hear your voice, for your voice is like the voice of dawn. And your appearance is beautiful.
verses.15: We saw small birds that were as beautiful as fruit trees. And our own fruit trees were also beautiful.
verses.16: My Lord, I am to You; and I will bless You in all things.
verses.17: Until today comes and the winds try to shape you into something like me, my dear. Or maybe they will make you resemble those waves that roll over the mountains in the distance.
